concept.title: Carers support and information
concept.shortdesc: Information, advice, assessments and support for people who care for family or friends, along with some information on advocacy and legal safeguards.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed, and unconfirmed: the group did not re-form reliably (stability 0.54). It is named only because a need points at it.

Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into support and information for unpaid carers, and information about independent advocacy and safeguards such as IMCA and Deprivation of Liberty Safeguards.
Did not recur reliably when the data was resampled; it is named only because a need points at it, so treat the name as a proposal and the group as unconfirmed.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-091. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
